summary: Configured /srv/drop on node1 as a persistent shared writable directory with sticky-bit deletion protection.
actions_performed: Created /srv/drop owned by root:root with mode 1777.
Verified nobody and daemon could both create files.
Verified daemon could not remove a file owned by nobody.
Restarted node1 safely and confirmed its boot identity changed.
Verified the directory mode, persisted test data, shared writes, and cross-user deletion protection after restart.

evidence.requirement: /srv/drop is shared writable with sticky-bit protection
evidence.summary: Direct stat showed root:root ownership and mode 1777; live tests showed two users could write while cross-user removal failed with Operation not permitted.

Captured pre-restart boot ID and persistent marker, received reboot acknowledgement, observed a changed boot ID, then confirmed the marker, mode 1777, shared writes, and sticky deletion protection recovered after restart.
